title: kate-fileio: store a Unicode line break as LF
summary: decode rewrites U+2028 and U+2029 to LF. A CR LF pair still becomes one LF. The test goes in the existing decode tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: decode.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add is_unicode_break. The body is matches!(ch, '\u{000B}' | '\u{000C}' | '\u{0085}' | '\u{2028}' | '\u{2029}'). In normalize_endings, add one else if before the else that pushes the scalar. else if is_unicode_break(ch) { 0 }. That arm does not call chars.next. The shared out.push of LF still runs. Do not nest an if inside an if. Keep the CR LF arm as one if with &&. Do not touch probably_binary, decode_payload, or majority. Update the module comment so a Unicode line break becomes LF. You may update that comment. Do not edit lib.rs. The existing tests adjacent_cr_and_lf_are_one_crlf and tied_endings_keep_the_earliest stay green. Do not rewrite their assertions. The test a_unicode_line_break_becomes_lf decodes the bytes of a, U+2028, b. The text is a, LF, b. The line ending is Lf. The bytes of a, U+2029, b also become a, LF, b. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: decode::tests::a_unicode_line_break_becomes_lf
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. a, U+2028, b stays three scalars. After the change the text is a, LF, b. A CR LF pair still becomes LF.
